method: Reread the adopted 2026–2027 TER arts. 4.1, 7.1 and 9.3, then checked the official degree scope and the 2026–2027 Ocasys entry for the selected specialisation before reconsidering the frozen audience, exact interests, active workbook and selected descriptions.
findings: The ordinary route has 60 EC in each year, with a 15 EC minor, two faculty units, one specialisation, a separate thesis seminar and 10 EC thesis. The thesis progression is 60 upper-year EC including Concepts and Methods 2. The two Methods courses are also prerequisites for Religion, Diversity and Identity. Alternative minor paths are not stacked with the ordinary choice.

The strongest UCR response gives specific coverage through myth and texts, visual heritage, religion in ancient Athens, beliefs and public life. The Western Art History change adds directly relevant visual analysis within the same feasible term; six advanced courses remain. The accepted related-fields option does not supply the external degree’s breadth of religious traditions, ritual or specialist methods.

Separate sustainability, sexual-health and spiritual-care, or education curricula would lack sustained religion-specific subject matter. There is one coherent accepted programme, so pairwise distinctness is not applicable.

The caution branch, reader-facing concept, term, route, note and actual course descriptions match their verified context. Optional independent research remains alongside the thesis and outside the scheduled credits.
